notes.optimize: Most "best settings" guides are generic and one-size-fits-all. These tweaks are the ones vetted safe AND reversible for a rig like yours — every one snapshots its prior state before it touches anything.
notes.diagnostics: Most people never see their PC's real parts list. This is the honest inventory — read straight from the machine, nothing installed.
notes.benchmark: Benchmarks are noisy: two identical runs never score identical. Compy grades changes against that noise floor, so luck can't be called a win.
notes.latency: One click crosses the mouse, USB, Windows, the GPU and your monitor before you see it land — every hop adds delay, and each one is measurable.
notes.tuning: Undervolting asks the chip to do the same work on less power — often cooler and just as fast. How far yours goes is the silicon lottery.
notes.blackbox: Windows keeps a flight recorder of every crash and freeze. Almost nobody ever reads it — this station does, in plain English.

journey.plan: 2 sessions of about 10 min: one as-is, then one with {{change}}.

journey.oneChange: One change per run. Compy keeps it only if it measures better, and puts it back otherwise. You can use the rest of Compy while you play. If Compy closes mid-test, the change stays on until you conclude or restore it in Test.
journey.asIs: Session 1 of 2: play {{game}} as usual for about 10 minutes. Compy stops measuring when you close the game.
journey.asIsNoGame: Session 1 of 2: play your game as usual for about 10 minutes. Compy stops measuring when you close the game.
journey.withChange: Session 2 of 2: {{change}} is on. Play {{game}} the same way for about 10 minutes, then close the game.
journey.enoughMore: Play the same area for about {{secs}} s more.
journey.enoughMoreMin: Play the same area for about {{min}} min more.
journey.enoughSettling: Keep playing the same area: the frame rate hasn't settled yet.
journey.enoughSettlingShort: Not settled yet. Keep playing this area.
journey.enough: Compy has enough; you can stop.
journey.enoughUnsettled: The frame rate in this game keeps changing, so it may not settle. You can stop now; Compy will count this session as uneven.
journey.enoughUnsettledShort: Keeps changing. Stop now; it counts as uneven.
journey.enoughUntraced: Compy can't see enough of the frame-rate trace to tell whether this session is steady. You can stop now.
journey.enoughUntracedShort: Can't check if it's steady. You can stop now.

putBackWhy.noChange: it made no difference Compy could measure
putBackWhy.regressed: the game ran worse with it
putBackWhy.confounded: something else changed during the test, so the result can't be trusted
putBackWhy.expired: the before-session was too old to compare against
putBackWhy.insufficientEvidence: there wasn't enough play with it on to judge
putBackWhy.notComparable: the two sessions were too different to compare fairly
putBackWhy.tooNoisy: the frame rate moved around too much to tell

journey.nextFresh: Next: {{change}}, about 20 min (a new before-session first)

retestWhy.inconclusive: {{change}} was tried before, but the frame rate moved around too much to judge. This run tries it again.
retestWhy.stale: {{change}} has a result from an older graphics driver or Windows build, so Compy can't say it still holds. This run checks it again.
retestWhy.unverified: {{change}} has a result Compy can't tie to this PC as it is now (no graphics driver or Windows build was recorded for it or for your newest session). This run records them.

journey.nothingLeft: Nothing else here is worth testing on this PC.

journey.notStarted: Compy didn't start the test, and nothing was changed: {{reason}}
journey.restoredNoReading: The game closed before Compy had a reading, so Compy put {{change}} back the way it was. Nothing was kept.
journey.restoredBehind: Compy didn't get a reading: another window was in front the whole time, so Compy put {{change}} back the way it was. Nothing was kept.
journey.restoredError: Something went wrong, so Compy put {{change}} back the way it was. Nothing was kept. ({{reason}})
journey.restoreFailed: Something went wrong, and Compy couldn't confirm {{change}} was put back. Check it in Test → Applied & history and undo it there. ({{reason}})
journey.captureFailed: Compy couldn't start measuring. If Windows asked for permission, allow it and try again.
journey.wrongGame: That session was {{played}}, not {{planned}}, so it can't be the before-reading. Nothing was changed.
journey.interrupted: A test was interrupted: {{change}} is still on. Conclude with your latest session or put it back.

summary.lessonRulesNote: Compy draws a lesson only from a fixed set of rules over its own stored results, never from guesses about causes. When no rule fits, it shows none.

rule.steadierNotFaster: the 1% low rose beyond the band and the average stayed within it.
rule.fasterAndSteadier: the 1% low and the average both rose beyond the band.
rule.fasterNotSteadier: the average rose beyond the band and the 1% low stayed within it.
rule.steadierButSlower: the 1% low rose beyond the band and the average fell beyond it.
rule.fasterButLessSteady: the average rose beyond the band and the 1% low fell beyond it.
rule.lessSteadyNotSlower: the 1% low fell beyond the band and the average stayed within it.
rule.slowerAndLessSteady: the 1% low and the average both fell beyond the band.
rule.slowerNotLessSteady: the average fell beyond the band and the 1% low stayed within it.
rule.steadier: the 1% low rose beyond the band; the average wasn't compared.
rule.lessSteady: the 1% low fell beyond the band; the average wasn't compared.
rule.tooNoisy: the newest Trial's verdict was too noisy to judge.
